hook: The world's biggest pumpkin grower isn't America. It's India.
twist: FAOSTAT 2024: India 9.33 million tonnes of pumpkins, squash and gourds, China 7.65, then Egypt, Russia, Ukraine; the US is sixth with 0.93, about a tenth of India.
angle: Halloween countdown 6 to 1 from one FAOSTAT table, ending with India and the ten-to-one gap. One big number: 9.3 million tonnes.
why_now: Halloween is 31 October 2026; slot 28 October. Data: FAOSTAT production for 2024 (bulk file dated 2025-12-23). Demand evidence is thin: YouTube search 'which country grows the most pumpkins' (2026-10-07) found the exact topic only at 15k views ('Which Country produces the most pumpkins?'); the pick rests on Halloween timing.
risks: FAO counts pumpkins, squash and gourds together: name the measure on screen.
Several figures are FAO estimates or imputations (China E, Egypt I, Russia I, Ukraine E): label them on screen.
